subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Restore
solution:
The correct answer is **"Destroy."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Restore** means to bring back to a former or original state. (व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु को उसकी पूर्व दशा या स्थिति में लाना)

 
 
• **Example**: *She **restores**__ old furniture as a hobby.*
 
 
 
• So, the opposite of this would be to **destroy**.
 
• **Destroy **means to damage or demolish completely. (किसी वस्‍तु को इस तरह हानि पहुँचाना कि वह इस्‍तेमाल न हो सके या समाप्‍त हो जाए, नष्‍ट करना)
 __
 
• **Example**:* The building was **destroyed**__ by fire.*
 
 
 
• The correct answer is Option 1.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Random** means without a definite purpose or pattern. (सांयोगिक, बेतरतीब, अनियमित, यादृच्छिक)
 
• **Recover** means to regain something lost or stolen. (बीमारी के बाद स्‍वास्‍थ्‍य लाभ करना)
 
• **Productive** means having the ability to produce or create something. (उत्‍पादित या उत्‍पन्‍न करने वाला (विशेषतः बड़े परिणाम में); उत्‍पादनकारी)
